'''Hillindor game fowl''', also known as '''Hillindor fowl''', was a type of edible bird from the [[Hillindor system/Legends|Hillindor system]]. It could be used to make [[Hillindor fowl soup]].<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
